name: cycle
description: Survey cycle the variable belongs to (1 or 2)

name: table_id
description: Data Basis table the variable was loaded into

name: column_name
description: Column name the variable maps to in that table

name: label
description: Variable label as published in the international codebook

name: domain
description: Thematic domain assigned by the codebook

name: level
description: Measurement level assigned by the codebook

name: bigquery_type
description: BigQuery type the variable was loaded as
observations: Assigned from an explicit unit rule, not from the codebook's level field, which disagrees across cycles

name: measurement_unit
description: Measurement unit, empty where the variable is not a quantity

name: item_code
description: Item the variable measures, for item-level variables only

name: measure
description: Which per-item measure it records, for item-level variables only
